kind: other
depth: focused
-- base/main.tf --
resource "aws_sqs_queue" "this" {
  name                      = "q"
  message_retention_seconds = 60
}

resource "aws_sns_topic" "this" {
  count = length(aws_sqs_queue.this.id) > 0 ? 1 : 0
  name  = "t"
}
-- head/main.tf --
resource "aws_sqs_queue" "this" {
  name                      = "q"
  message_retention_seconds = 120
}

resource "aws_sns_topic" "this" {
  count = length(aws_sqs_queue.this.id) > 0 ? 1 : 0
  name  = "t"
}
